method: Isolated temp MemoryStore DBs (mkdtemp in os.tmpdir), project scope, no real DSH DB read or modified
limitations: Synthetic knowledge bodies, not real agent trajectories
No wall-clock time measurement without real agent loop
mostWorthImproving: Top-1 accuracy 30-60% vs top-5 90-100%: lexical/FTS matching sometimes ranks a sibling/negative above the exact fix. Agents read top 1-2 — improving top-1 precision (stronger semantic query-to-body matching, evidence-weighted boost) has the biggest practical impact.
